kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتقارب (form VI)
# نَتَقَارَبُ (nataqārabu) /na.ta.qaː.ra.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَارَبَ (taqāraba)
# نَتَقَارَبَ (nataqāraba) /na.ta.qaː.ra.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَارَبَ (taqāraba)
# نَتَقَارَبْ (nataqārab) /na.ta.qaː.rab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَارَبَ (taqāraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
